services.desc: Note: tours start in multiple locations. We recommend leaving 30 minutes between tours when scheduling more than one experience. If you haven’t toured the farm, you haven’t experienced Olana! Walk through Frederic Church’s exquisite masterwork of landscape design and learn about the farm that served as his passion and inspiration throughout the family’s life at Olana. Explore the bucolic landscape of the meadows, farm buildings, Cosy Cottage, woodlands and hand-dug lake that composed the family’s first and most-enduring home and initiated Church’s masterwork of landscape architecture. services.desc: The work of Frederic Edwin Church (1826-1900), renowned American landscape painter, was indelibly shaped by global travel. Church’s art was defined by place: early trips took him to South America, across the northeastern United States, and to the Arctic; later he visited the Caribbean, Europe, and the Middle East; in his final decades, he spent long sojourns in Mexico. The designed landscapes, extensive collections, and striking architecture of his home, Olana reflect the many worlds through which he traveled.
